brand_dna.category: Ethically sourced specialty coffee roaster selling espresso and filter beans plus coffee-based lifestyle merch, playing in the conscience-driven premium lane.
brand_dna.core_belief: The coffee industry is broken - so SAAZAA is on a mission not just to brew the best cup but to brew a better future for everyone through owned farms, fair pay and community impact.
proof_points: Owns its own farms for complete control of the supply chain, leading to happier farmers and a better bean
Single origins and blends sourced from Kenya, Ethiopia, Guatemala, Colombia and El Salvador with named origins per product
Maji decaf uses the Swiss Water method, decaffeinated completely free from chemicals
Community commitments: fair farmer wages, building schools and hospitals, and fundraising to support the Maasai Tribe
brand_dna.positioning: Premium, purpose-led and down-to-earth - specialty quality with an ethical supply chain, not mass-market convenience coffee.

voice_pillars.name: Bold and Mission-Driven
voice_pillars.desc: Speaks with conviction about fixing a broken industry and calls the customer up to think bigger.
voice_pillars.quote: We think big, aim high, and act bold. You should too.

voice_pillars.name: Warm and Down to Earth
voice_pillars.desc: Human, inviting language that treats coffee as joy and people as family, not a transaction.

voice_pillars.name: Transparent and Detail-Obsessed
voice_pillars.desc: Backs claims with specifics on sourcing, farmers and process, defining exactly what it means.
voice_pillars.quote: We're relentless about every detail, from the beans' soil to the roasting process and packaging

voice_pillars.name: Craft and Sensory
voice_pillars.desc: Describes each bean with vivid tasting notes and precise brew detail so quality feels tangible.
voice_pillars.quote: you can expect smooth, mellow vibes from your cup of Sukari

phrases: smooth, mellow vibes from your cup
Good Coffee is Down to Earth

icp: Conscious coffee lovers who care about how their beans are grown and who gets paid, and happily pay premium for quality with a transparent, ethical story behind it.

personas.name: Ethical Sipper
personas.description: Values-driven buyer who chooses brands by supply-chain ethics and impact - move them with fair pay, owned farms and community projects.

personas.name: Home Barista
personas.description: Detail-loving enthusiast who dials in shots at home - move them with origins, tasting notes and precise brew guides.

personas.name: Gift and Ritual Seeker
personas.description: Shopper buying beans, candles, scrubs or tees as a treat or gift - move them with the sensory, joy-in-every-cup lifestyle angle.

offers: Multiple grind options including Whole Beans, Espresso, Plunger, Aeropress, Stovetop, Cold Brew and Pour Over
Subscription / recurring purchase available on beans
Free community event: No Woman, No Cry on October 26th

banned.claim: Coffee that boosts your immunity or metabolism.
banned.why: Banned health claim - 'boosts immunity' / 'burns fat' style claims are not permitted for food and beverage.

banned.claim: Detoxes your body with every cup.
banned.why: Unqualified 'detox' claim is banned for this category.

banned.claim: Drink this to treat or prevent any illness.

banned.why: Nutrient-content claims must match an actual product label, which is not shown on site.

banned.claim: 'All natural' or 'clean coffee' as a headline claim.
banned.why: 'Natural' and 'clean' are vague and risky as headline claims.
FTC Green Guides - unqualified sustainability claim; use specific, provable statements instead.
